technical.summary: Long-term structure bullish but short-term momentum severely depressed with no reversal confirmation; oversold conditions lack supporting volume and oscillator confirmation for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: CNP shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 36 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for conviction.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (15/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but stale congressional data (2+ years old) and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (328.96) indicates extreme market stress, rising DXY pressures multinationals, and earnings in 36 days adds event risk to utilities sector already facing credit stress.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term EMA/SMA bullish structure with supertrend confirmation and extreme fear sentiment (15/100) create contrarian setup near support (27.91), offering asymmetric risk/reward if macro stress reverses.
debate.key_bear_argument: Short-term momentum completely absent (RSI oversold but not rising, MACD negative, CMF negative, OVB flat, ADX weak 10.25), no volume confirmation, inverted yield curve + VIX crisis + earnings in 36 days create compounding event risks that invalidate long-term structure.
